title: Defer vision-student distillation until teacher acceptance
doing: Keep a future student comparison of four-frame pixel stacks with KL/value supervision and an optional spatial-threat auxiliary head, at least two training seeds per arm. Teacher/controller adoption, observable targets, model/pixel pipeline qualification and a separate data/resource budget precede any collection or training.
expected: A stronger validated teacher may make vision distillation useful; privileged teacher success does not prove a student can infer all necessary state from pixels. This remains the last stage rather than a current launch request.

evidence.label: User priority-order steer, reviewed with current local evidence
